name: Shiraoi (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Shiraoi town emblem in white: concentric broken rings enclosing a hexagon with a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shiraoi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1984.

features.role: Shiraoi town emblem — concentric broken rings enclosing a hexagon with a disc
